error_reason: The Planner failed to correctly evaluate the change in net force upon chute deployment; specifically, it incorrectly assumed acceleration remained positive (downward) when the sudden drag force makes the net force upward (negative), directly causing the selection of the wrong option.

hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly deduced that acceleration remains constant (positive) after the chute opens. While velocity stays positive, the opening of the chute introduces a large upward drag force, causing the net acceleration to become negative (deceleration) relative to the downward positive direction. Failing to calculate or logically verify the change in net force/acceleration led directly to the wrong conclusion.
hypotheses.check: Verify if the Planner correctly identified that net acceleration changes from positive (gravity only) to negative (gravity minus large drag force) when the parachute opens, rather than assuming acceleration remains constant.
